overview.description: Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife reserve located in Ravangla, near Namchi City in the Namchi district of the Indian state of Sikkim covering an area of around 35 square kilometres (14 sq mi). The literal meaning of maenam-la is "treasure-house of medicines", and the flora of the sanctuary is rich in a number of plants of medicinal value. Established in 1987, Maenam wildlife sanctuary lies 34 kilometres (21 mi) from Namchi City, the district headquarter, 65 kilometres (40 mi) southwest of the state capital Gangtok and is a popular tourist destination.

topPlaces.name: Buddha Park of Ravangla (Tathagata Tsal)
topPlaces.description: World-renowned spiritual sanctuary featuring an awe-inspiring 130-foot gilded statue of Shakyamuni Buddha set within landscaped gardens against the majestic backdrop of Mount Narsing.

image.alt: Buddha Park of Ravangla (Tathagata Tsal) scenic view in South Sikkim

topPlaces.name: Ralang Monastery (Palchen Choeling Institute)
topPlaces.description: One of the most sacred Kagyu Buddhist monasteries in Sikkim, renowned for magnificent Tibetan murals, golden stupas, and grand annual Mahakala mask dances.

image.alt: Ralang Monastery (Palchen Choeling Institute) — Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary, Sikkim scenic view

topPlaces.name: Bhaleydhunga Cliff & Skywalk Trail
topPlaces.description: A thrilling high-altitude rocky promontory resembling a rooster’s head, offering jaw-dropping views of the Teesta River flowing 3,000 feet below and the proposed glass skywalk.

image.alt: Bhaleydhunga Cliff & Skywalk Trail — Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary, Sikkim scenic view

topPlaces.name: Temi Tea Garden (South Sikkim)
topPlaces.description: The sole commercial tea estate in Sikkim, cascading over 440 acres of rolling slopes producing world-class organic tea amidst cherry blossom trees and Kanchenjunga views.

image.alt: Temi Tea Garden (South Sikkim) scenic view in South Sikkim

topPlaces.name: Bon Monastery, Kewzing
topPlaces.description: One of only two monasteries in India belonging to the ancient pre-Buddhist Yungdrung Bon tradition, adorned with rare iconography and peaceful forest surroundings.

image.alt: Bon Monastery, Kewzing scenic view in South Sikkim

topPlaces.name: Rayong Sunrise Viewpoint
topPlaces.description: A panoramic viewpoint situated along the Ravangla-Damthang road offering unobstructed vistas of the first rays of dawn illuminating Mount Kanchenjunga and Chola range.

image.alt: Rayong Sunrise Viewpoint scenic view in South Sikkim

topPlaces.name: Borong Hot Springs (Borong Tsachu)
topPlaces.description: Natural sulfurous thermal springs situated along the banks of the Rangit River, revered for therapeutic mineral properties amidst tranquil riverine forests.

image.alt: Borong Hot Springs (Borong Tsachu) — Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary, Sikkim scenic view

topPlaces.name: Ravangla Forest Canopy & Alpine Valley
topPlaces.description: Dense temperate forest groves surrounding the hill settlement of Ravangla, famous for birdwatching, blooming magnolia trees, and scenic hill walks.

image.alt: Ravangla Forest Canopy & Alpine Valley scenic view in South Sikkim

items.note: Admire the 130-foot monumental golden Buddha statue set against Mount Narsing.
Walk through the lush terraced tea slopes and taste world-class organic Himalayan tea.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The best time to visit Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary is Mar – Jun, Sep – Nov. Summers are 15–28°C and winters are 2–16°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Siliguri Junction (69 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: Stays in Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary start from ₹2,500 per night, with options across 5 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Maenam Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The top attractions are Buddha Park of Ravangla, Ralang Monastery, Bhaleydhunga Cliff, Temi Tea Garden, Bon Monastery, and Rayong Sunrise Viewpoint.
